notes: Corrugated-iron skillion-roof house. The enclosed part is about 11.3 x 5.1 m, with a 2.2 m shade-clothed veranda across the front, an open woodshed lean-to on the +x end and a rainwater tank on the -x end. Overall it is about 14.8 x 3.2 x 7.6 m, taken from the 1 m scale bar (about 60 px/m on the front view). The sheet's views disagree with each other. The top view is squashed to about half the depth. The back view draws the eave sloping; I modelled it level, with the skillion falling to the front as the side views and three-quarter view show. The side views leave out the lean-to.
